name: Trackdesk for WooCommerce
author: trackdesk

sections.description:
WordPress Affiliate Tracking Plugin

Trackdesk is affiliate management software built for scalability, transparency, and growth. It enables businesses to launch, manage, track, and optimize affiliate, referral, influencer, and partner programs from a single platform.

Trackdesk for WooCommerce connects your store to your Trackdesk account, so every WooCommerce order is attributed to the partner who drove it in real time. Install the plugin, add your tracking code, and start attributing sales without editing theme files or writing custom code.

Beyond WooCommerce, Trackdesk builds AI into commission setup, payout review, and revenue reporting. A native MCP server lets you run the whole program from AI clients like Claude and Cursor, and 900+ integrations keep your marketing and payment stack in sync.

Trackdesk runs on transparent, revenue-based pricing, and a dedicated team handles your full migration from any existing platform, so your program keeps running through the switch.

Setup instructions:
https://help.trackdesk.com/en/articles/7188110-woocommerce-plugin-integration

Plans and full feature list:
https://trackdesk.com/pricing

Key Features

  • Automatic order and conversion tracking inside WooCommerce
  • Subscription tracking through the WooCommerce Subscriptions plugin
  • Order-status sync, so refunds and cancellations update automatically
  • Native MCP server: manage your program from Claude, Cursor, and any MCP-compatible AI client
  • AI tools: Commission Advisor, Postback Assistant, and Revenue Intelligence
  • Every commission model: RevShare, CPA, CPS, CPL, hybrid, tiered, and MLM
  • Automated payouts in fiat and crypto via Wise, PayPal, and Tipalti
  • Built-in fraud detection scoring every conversion
  • 900+ native integrations across your marketing and payment stack
  • Real-time affiliate dashboards and a shared hub for creative assets
  • Error log for fast troubleshooting on the store side
  • ISO 27001 certified, GDPR and CCPA aligned, EU data residency
  • Access to the Trackdesk Partnership Managers Marketplace

Support

If you need support or think you found a bug, contact us here.
sections.installation:
1. Install easily with the WordPress plugin control panel or manually download the plugin and upload the folder trackdesk-for-woocommerce to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Fill required fields and enable plugin functionality in the settings (Admin > WooCommerce > Trackdesk)
